name: baysol-tui
description: A terminal front end for BAYSOL: pick a project, edit its settings, and (soon) run fits and read the results, all from the keyboard. It was plain Clojure on the JVM ([Lanterna](https://github.com/mabe02/lanterna)), and ran in any terminal that was at least 80 columns by 24 rows. It looks best with 24-bit colour (most current terminals); without it the screens are black on white.
